item.text:
- **Models:** Agents can use any model available for Mistral’s Chat Completions API. There is no separate handoff-specific model restriction. The documentation’s examples use `mistral-medium-latest` and `mistral-large-latest`. [Agents & Conversations](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agents-api) · [Handoffs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/handoffs)

- **Handoff limit:** There is **no limit** on how many chained handoffs a workflow can contain. [Handoffs documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/handoffs)
